response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS AboveOverall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg;

assumptions.assumption: Each track contributes its own ratio Bytes/Milliseconds, and the per-media-type value is the unweighted mean of those per-track ratios. The CAST to REAL avoids integer truncation. Tracks with Bytes NULL or not above 10,323,804 are excluded by the WHERE clause.

Grouping is by MediaTypeId with Name, so each media type is one group even if two types share a name. The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages, as the request specifies.

alternatives.interpretation: The per-media-type average is a ratio of totals: the sum of Bytes divided by the sum of Milliseconds across the qualifying tracks, rather than the mean of per-track ratios. The overall simple average of those per-type values is unchanged.
